_readme: Publications listed here are added to data/publications.json alongside
whatever fetch_orcid.py pulls from ORCID - they are NOT overwritten by
the weekly sync, unlike data/publications.json itself.
Use this for anything ORCID doesn't have: talks, book chapters, items
from before someone's ORCID profile existed, or corrections to an
ORCID record you don't want to fix upstream.
1. Add an object to the "publications" array below.
2. "key" is required and must be unique - use the DOI (lowercase) if
there is one, otherwise lowercase-hyphenated-title::year (see the
existing entries in data/publications.json for the exact pattern).
3. If your key matches one ORCID already fetched, this entry WINS -
useful for fixing a bad title/author list without editing ORCID.
4. Don't forget to also tag it in data/lab-tags.json once it's synced.
5. Commit the change - it takes effect on the next sync run (or you
can trigger one manually from the Actions tab).
